title: Origin story: Erlang Shen
description: Erlang Shen was the nephew of the Jade Emperor, born of his sister and a mortal. He split Mount Tao with his axe to save his mother, then became heaven's greatest demon-hunter, leading the campaign that finally captured Sun Wukong — the one general the Monkey King respected.

title: Ability profile: Erlang Shen
description: Ranked abilities: Third-eye sight — rank 99/100; Combat — rank 98/100; Justice — rank 96/100; Endurance — rank 95/100; Leadership — rank 93/100.

title: Power ranking: Erlang Shen
description: Powers: The third eye that sees all truth and illusion; The three-pointed double-edged spear; Xiaotian, the heaven-hound that hunts demons.

title: Stamina feats: Erlang Shen
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Pursued Wukong across heaven and earth; Hunts without rest through the mortal realm.

title: Crossover notes: Erlang Shen
description: Erlang Shen crosses naturally with: justice, demon-hunting, the third eye.

title: Cultural impact: Erlang Shen
description: The stern counterpoint to the Monkey King; justice without compromise.
